# dsh-teaching-mode
> A switchable **teaching mode** for DeepSeek Harness: one mini-topic at a time → quiz right after →
topic wrap-up quiz → section review sheet.

- **Off by default** — it never interferes with ordinary conversations.
- Turn it on with `/teaching

on`, off with `/teaching off`.
- State is kept **per session**; one session studies one course.
## Why
Asking an AI to teach you inside a long chat usually fails in three ways:

1. **It dumps everything at once** — thousands of words in one reply, nothing retained.
2. **It neve

r tests you** — you cannot tell what you actually understood.
3. **Nothing is kept** — the material
lives in the chat log and is painful to revisit weeks later.
This plugin turns "explain → quiz → file it away" into a protocol that is injected into every model
request, so the model keeps a teacher's rhythm instead of lecturing.
## The teaching loop
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Hard rules**

- One topic at a time; quiz immediately after explaining.
- Never dump a whole topic at once — split

it into mini-topics.
- Each mini-topic → 1 card question; each finished topic → 2 more.
- Each fini

shed section → a review sheet, written to disk (not only in chat).
- Explain *why*, not just *what*:

every symbol and rule gets its meaning and reason.
- Heading counts must match content counts; labe

l a table as a summary when it is not the textbook's own wording.
- Homework: answers and walkthroug
hs only, **no** follow-up quizzes.
**Prep gate (v0.9.0)** — before any teaching starts the model must settle four things with you: text
book table of contents / missing pages, past papers, chapter route, exam info. Until then it asks in
stead of teaching; a lesson that has already started only gets a softer reminder.
**Generating material one chapter at a time** (when no textbook is at hand)
1. Ask for the subject and material first; if material exists, check its table of contents / page co

mpleteness.
2. No material → give the **outline** (chapter → section → topic) and wait for approval.
3. Then generate **the first chapter only** — never the whole book; generated text is labelled as g

enerated.
4. Finish chapter 1, then ask whether to generate chapter 2. Never run ahead.
## Install
Published on npm: `dsh-teaching-mode`
[代码示例省略，未执行]
In the desktop app the CLI is **not allowed to manage the `desktop` profile** (the app owns it), so
install from inside the app: open a DSH session and have it run `plugin_manager` → `install_bundle`
with target `dsh-teaching-mode` — the package name; DSH resolves it from npm.
From a local checkout instead: clone the repo, then use `install_bundle` with target `file:<absolute
-path-to-the-cloned-folder>`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH (or reload the profile) afterwards.
## UI
Two surfaces, both native DSH UI:
| Where | What |
| **Settings → Teaching** | Plugin summary, a "default on for new sessions" switch, the teaching loo

p, hard rules and command list |
| **Conversation "Teaching" tab** | Sits next to "Chain of thought"
/ "Request context"; the loop and rules always at hand |
> The settings switch is a **local preference** (browser storage) meaning "start new sessions in tea
ching mode". Toggling a specific session still uses `/teaching on` / `/teaching off`.
## Notes are written to disk automatically
You do not have to ask. When a section is finished, its notes and review sheet are written to files:
| Content | Filename |

| Section notes | `第X章-<section>-讲义.md` |
| Section review sheet | `第X章-<section>-复习资料.md` (concepts

+ exercises + answers) |
| Chapter review | `第X章-总复习.md` |
| Mistake book | `错题本.md` |
Filenames follow the student's language on purpose: the course, its folders and its notes are Chines
e, so the files stay sortable next to the rest of the course material.
**Where**: `<this session's working directory>/projects/<subject>/03-产出/` — inside that conversation
's own folder, not left in the chat log. The path is derived from `Session.header.cwd` plus the subj
ect set with `/teaching setup`; `/teaching status` shows the current notes directory.
## Continuing a course in a new session (v0.9.3)
A course often outlives one conversation. The plugin therefore does not key a course on the session,
but on **which course it is**:

- Subject names are normalised first (`高等数学（同济第七版上册）` and `高等数学（同济第七版）` are the same course).
- When
the notes directory of a new session does not exist, the plugin reuses the existing `projects/<subj

ect>/03-产出` instead of creating an empty one, and says so.
- Sessions of the same course are merged

(progress, sections, debts, mistakes) every time the plugin starts.
- A session with teaching mode s
till off sees a short hint listing **the courses already in this workspace** (progress, sections tau

ght, open debts) so it can continue instead of starting from scratch.
- `/teaching courses` lists ev
ery course with its sessions; `/teaching link <8-hex-prefix>` copies a course's fields into the curr
ith its sessions; `/teaching link <8-hex-prefix>` copies a course's fields into the current session.
## Commands
Progress can be recorded at three granularities: **section** (小节), **topic/section step** (知识点 / 小知识
点) and **chapter** (章).
| Command | Effect |

| `/teaching on` / `off` | Enable / disable teaching mode for this session |
| `/teaching status` |

Show subject, material, progress, debts |
| `/teaching setup <subject> \| <material>` | Set subject

and textbook; re-derives the notes directory |
| `/teaching progress <text>` | Update current progre

ss, e.g. `/teaching progress 第8章 8.5 数据有多长` |
[该节后续省略]
## Protocol size (why it does not get slower)
After a course has taught 5+ sections the plugin injects a compact rule set (~1.1k characters) inste
ad of the full protocol (~4.4k), and the state header only shows the latest items. A typical turn in
jects ~1.8k characters instead of ~4.8k. The notes index is rebuilt only when the file list actually
changed, so tool calls no longer scan the directory every time.
